label: A3 same-event transport under type-global occurrence uniqueness (inference)
meaning: Prove the universally quantified conditional transport law under TYPE-GLOBAL selected uniqueness: the antecedent requires every term of the occurrence type sharing the selected state-pair, occurring or not, to equal the selected occurrence, and possible conditioning of a matching occurrence. That antecedent forces a single bearer and ordered interval, so this law does not bridge to the occurrence reading with repeated realizations; it is superseded as the sense bridge by the accessible-occurrence transport law. This does not discharge A3P1 or infer actual causation.
